# 12-Week Strength Programme: 1 June to 23 August 2026

## Assumptions to confirm
- **Predicted flow days** (27-day cycle from 4 May, 4 flow days): 31 May to 3 Jun, 27 to 30 Jun, 24 to 27 Jul, and 20 to 23 Aug. If her period arrives early or late, apply Amber rules to the actual flow days.
- **Flare windows:** 10 to 13 Jul and 4 to 7 Aug.
- **Post-laparoscopy follow-up (10 to 13 Jul):** I've treated this as a symptom window, as you described it. If a procedure or surgical review falls in or just before it, get written clearance from her surgeon. Post-op restrictions are usually stricter than "no HIIT, Valsalva or jumping".
- **Format:** 4 sessions a week (Mon Lower A, Tue Upper A, Thu Lower B, Fri Upper B), plus an optional Saturday conditioning or mobility session.

## Green vs Amber days
**Green (fully cleared):** normal programming. Brief bracing on heavy sets is fine.

**Amber (flow days and flare days):**
- Cap effort at RPE 6 to 7 and do 2 to 3 sets of 10 to 15 reps at a 3-1-0 tempo.
- Breathe out on the effort, with no breath-holding.
- Use machines, supported or unilateral variations. No jumps, hops, skipping, swings, or ballistic work.
- Conditioning is walking or easy Zone 2 only, with no intervals.

**Standard Amber swaps:**

| Planned | Amber version |
|---|---|
| Back squat / trap bar deadlift | Leg press or goblet box squat; cable pull-through |
| Heavy RDL | Light DB RDL or back extension (bodyweight) |
| Barbell/DB press | Machine press or light DB press, higher reps |
| Pull-ups | Lat pulldown, light |
| Loaded step-ups/lunges | Supported split squat or bodyweight |
| Heavy core bracing | Dead bug, Pallof press, breathing-focused work |

## Amber calendar
| Date | Day | Session affected | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Jun | Mon | Lower A | Flow |
| 2 Jun | Tue | Upper A | Flow |
| 29 Jun | Mon | Lower A | Flow |
| 30 Jun | Tue | Upper A | Flow |
| 10 Jul | Fri | Upper B | Flare |
| 13 Jul | Mon | Lower A | Flare |
| 24 Jul | Fri | Upper B | Flow |
| 27 Jul | Mon | Lower A | Flow |
| 4 Aug | Tue | Upper A | Flare |
| 6 Aug | Thu | Lower B moves to Sat 8 Aug | Flare |
| 7 Aug | Fri | Upper B | Flare |
| 20 Aug | Thu | Lower B | Flow |
| 21 Aug | Fri | Upper B | Flow |

The 3 Jun flow day (Wednesday) is a rest day. The weekend flow days in late June, July and August fall on non-training days, so keep them for rest or walking.

---

## Phase 1: Foundation and Hypertrophy (Weeks 1 to 4, 1 to 28 Jun)
**Goal:** build a movement baseline and work capacity. Use 3 sets of 8 to 12 reps at RPE 6 to 8, adding about 2.5 to 5% load per week.

**Lower A:** Back squat or goblet squat 3x8-10, DB RDL 3x10, Split squat 3x10/side, Hip thrust 3x10-12, Standing calf raise 3x12-15, Pallof press 3x10/side.

**Upper A:** DB bench press 3x8-10, Chest-supported row 3x10, Seated DB overhead press 3x10, Lat pulldown 3x10-12, Face pull 2x15, Biceps curl and triceps pushdown 2x12.

**Lower B:** Leg press 3x10-12, Trap bar deadlift 3x8 (moderate), Step-up 3x10/side, Seated or lying leg curl 3x12, Hip abduction 2x15, Side plank 3x20-30 s.

**Upper B:** Incline DB press 3x10, Assisted pull-up or pulldown 3x8-10, Cable row 3x10-12, Lateral raise 3x12-15, Push-up variation 2xAMRAP (RPE 8), Rear-delt fly 2x15.

**Week notes:**
- **Week 1 (1 to 7 Jun):** Mon and Tue are Amber, so run Lower A and Upper A at 2 sets each with the Amber swaps and learn the technique. Thu and Fri are Green and are the first real loading.
- **Weeks 2 to 3:** full Green weeks. Add load or a rep each week.
- **Week 4:** Green. Push the final week of the block to RPE 8. The 27 to 30 Jun flow starts at the weekend, so keep Sat and Sun as rest or walking.

**Optional Saturday:** 25 to 30 min Zone 2, plus mobility.

---

## Phase 2: Strength Build (Weeks 5 to 8, 29 Jun to 26 Jul)
**Goal:** raise top-end strength. Main lifts are 4 to 5 sets of 4 to 6 reps at RPE 7 to 8.5, and accessories are 3x8-10.

**Lower A:** Back squat, Romanian deadlift 3x6-8, Walking lunge or split squat 3x8/side, Hip thrust 3x8, Calf raise 3x10, Pallof press 3x10.

**Upper A:** Barbell or DB bench press, Barbell or chest-supported row 4x6, Standing or seated overhead press 3x6-8, Pull-up or pulldown 3x6-8, Face pull 3x15, Curl and pushdown 2x10-12.

**Lower B:** Trap bar deadlift, Front squat or leg press 3x8, Bulgarian split squat 3x8/side, Leg curl 3x10, Hip abduction 2x15, Weighted side plank 3x20-30 s.

**Upper B:** Incline press 4x6-8, Weighted pull-up or pulldown 4x6-8, Cable row 3x10, Lateral raise 3x15, DB push press replaced by strict press 3x8, Arm work 2x12.

**Week notes:**
- **Week 5 (29 Jun to 5 Jul):** the main lifts are 4x6 at RPE 7. Mon and Tue are Amber (flow), so the Green sessions are Thu and Fri. If her flow runs longer than 4 days, keep Amber.
- **Week 6 (6 to 12 Jul):** the main lifts are 4x5 at RPE 8. Mon to Thu are Green. Fri 10 Jul is Amber (flare), so cut Upper B to the Amber version and don't make up the lost volume. Keep the weekend easy, since the flare window continues.
- **Week 7 (13 to 19 Jul):** Mon 13 Jul is Amber (last flare day), so run an easy Lower A. Tue to Fri are Green. Run Tue at about 90% of planned load as a ramp back, then progress normally for the rest of the week.
- **Week 8 (20 to 26 Jul), deload:** cut volume by about 30% and hold loads at RPE 6 to 7. This also covers the Fri 24 Jul flow start, so Upper B on Friday is Amber anyway.

**Optional Saturday:** 25 to 30 min Zone 2 on Amber-adjacent weeks. On Green weeks she can do 6 to 8 x 30 s hard efforts on a bike or rower with 90 s easy, but not within a flare or flow window.

---

## Phase 3: Peak and Consolidate (Weeks 9 to 12, 27 Jul to 23 Aug)
**Goal:** peak strength. Main lifts are 4 to 5 sets of 3 to 5 reps at RPE 8 to 9, and accessories 2 to 3 sets of 8 to 10.

Use the Phase 2 session templates with the same exercises, adding load. Keep lower-back and hip work moderate.

**Week notes:**
- **Week 9 (27 Jul to 2 Aug):** Mon 27 Jul is Amber (flow, last day). Tue to Fri are Green, with main lifts at 4x5 at RPE 8.
- **Week 10 (3 to 9 Aug), flare-adjusted:**
  - Mon 3 Aug: a normal Green Lower A, with main lifts at 4x4 at RPE 8.
  - Tue 4 Aug: Upper A Amber.
  - Thu 6 Aug: Lower B is moved to Sat 8 Aug (Green) with the flare over. Thu is a rest day or a walk.
  - Fri 7 Aug: Upper B Amber.
  - Overall, drop volume by about 20 to 30% this week and do not try to recover it.
- **Week 11 (10 to 16 Aug):** the peak week. Run 5x3 to 4 at RPE 8.5 to 9 on the main lifts, with all four sessions Green. Reduce accessory volume slightly.
- **Week 12 (17 to 23 Aug), deload and assessment:**
  - Mon 17 and Tue 18 Aug are Green. Work up to a top set of 3 at RPE 8 to 9 on squat and bench instead of a 1RM test, which avoids heavy maximal Valsalva.
  - Thu 20 Aug (Lower B) and Fri 21 Aug (Upper B) are Amber (flow).
  - Retest with estimated 1RM from rep sets after the cycle if you want a clean number.

---

## Recovery and nutrition notes (brief)
- **Protein:** about 1.6 to 2.0 g/kg per day, spread across 3 to 4 meals.
- **Sleep:** aim for 7 to 9 hours, and protect it during flare windows.
- **Flare days:** daily walking, gentle mobility, and heat if she finds it helpful. Autoregulate by dropping to Amber on any other day she reports a flare, even outside the flagged windows.
- **Track:** simple daily notes on pain (0 to 10), energy, and sleep, so you can adjust the next cycle's schedule.
- **Scope:** dietary changes beyond general guidance, and pain management, should go through her gynaecologist or physio.
